answer: To mitigate fake-identity attacks, AI agents can employ a mechanism known as "Proof of Work-based Reputation Systems." In this approach, agents must solve computationally intensive puzzles to maintain their reputation, effectively creating an "ember" of continuous validation. The rarity of solutions serves as a "pearl" of scarcity, discouraging malicious agents from creating fake identities. However, the energy expenditure required to solve these puzzles can lead to a "glacier" of slow network consensus, potentially hindering legitimate transactions.
